question: Are any currently open Stellar RFPs relevant to smart accounts or passkeys, and how do the returned briefs differ?

golden.answer: Fetch the full current open set with scout.getRfps({status:"open"}), then locally filter titles, descriptions, and technical requirements for related passkey and smart-account concepts. A q-filtered call may supplement but not replace the exhaustive open-set scan. Cite deliverables and dated round metadata. Do not infer that a matching open brief proves an SCF full-proposal window is open.
keyFacts: Fetches the full open RFP set first, then locally filters related passkey/smart-account concepts.
Compares stated deliverables and cites each returned brief.
Includes round as-of/verifyAt and scopes an empty result to the source.
Separates brief status from the SCF round submission phase.
avoid: Claims a remembered passkey brief is still open without current status evidence.
A narrow zero/one-hit query is not an exhaustive opportunity scan.
Claims that an open brief proves the current SCF round accepts a new full proposal.

corroboration.claim: Relevant briefs must be selected from the complete current open set, compared by deliverables, cited, and dated without inferring that the SCF submission window is open.

evidence.note: Live response returned the complete served open set and round metadata showing #45 Initial Review with no submission window.
Official awards index independently showed #45 in Initial Review.
Exposed operation supports the exhaustive status=open call and local filtering behavior.

corroboration.claim: An archived passkey brief is necessarily still open.
